title: H09 — Preprocessing / Min-Max Normalization
prompt: The file data/housing_dataset.csv contains housing price data. Perform data preprocessing: encode the furnishingstatus column as numeric (furnished=2, semi-furnished=1, unfurnished=0), encode all yes/no columns as binary (yes=1, no=0), and normalise the price and area columns using min-max scaling. Report the mean of the normalised price column and the mean of the normalised area column after preprocessing. Report your answer in this exact format: @mean_norm_price[value] @mean_norm_area[value] where both values are rounded to four decimal places.
notes: Output-format non-compliance: missing brackets around both values
